content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the Apply button at about x=1400, y=850 receives repeated clicks (ids 277, 279, 283, 287, 291, 294 in the first window) within the 0.9 s to 1.4 s span the insight reports, with no navigation or other event between them, which suggests the first click gave no clear result and the user clicked again.", "fix": "Fix: on the sales invoice:new screen, disable the Apply button and show a pending state from its first click until the update completes, so a second click at the same spot cannot fire until the first finishes.", "cited_event_ids": ["277", "279", "283", "287", "291", "294"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["Whether the Apply button gives any visible response is not recorded in the events", "The reason for the repeated clicks is inferred from their timing and the absence of other events", "Pointer samples were dropped (about 580 to 595 per session), so cursor movement is incomplete"]}
